digest.en: Yemeni government forces retreated from the strait, marking a major setback against the Houthis. Simultaneously, Bahrain intercepted Iranian attacks while Tehran claimed a strike on a US base. These moves tighten the security perimeter across the Gulf.
digest.hi: नई दिल्ली में भाजपा का चिंतन शिविर मथुरा में शुरू हो गया है, जहां योगी आदित्यनाथ सहित कई दिग्गज शामिल हैं। इसी समय बेलारूस के विदेश मंत्री भारत में जितिन प्रसाद से मुलाकात के लिए पहुंचे हैं। ये दोनों घटनाक्रम अलग-अलग दिशाओं में भारत की राजनीतिक और कूटनीतिक रणनीति को दर्शाते हैं।

articles.title: Yemeni government forces retreat from strait in major setback in war against Houthis
articles.summary: Yemeni government forces pulled back from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, marking a significant tactical loss in their campaign against the Houthi movement. This retreat follows a period of sustained Houthi advances and direct attacks on Saudi Arabia and commercial shipping in the Red Sea. The shifting balance on the ground has bolstered Iran's strategic position within the broader regional conflict. The situation reflects the ongoing pressure from the Houthi campaign that has intensified since the US and Israel launched operations in February.

articles.title: Central Asia's AI Race: Big Ambitions, Even Bigger Risks
articles.summary: Central Asian governments are pursuing AI hub status while critics highlight financing gaps and reliance on fossil fuels. The region faces transparency issues amid long-standing corruption concerns. These structural weaknesses threaten the viability of their digital infrastructure plans. Across Central Asia, governments are racing to become the next global AI hub. Yet critics are flagging shaky financing, over reliance on dirty power, and a lack of transparency in a region long plagued by corruption.

articles.title: Barred By The Taliban, Afghan Girls And Women Now Shut Out Of School In Iran And Pakistan Too
articles.summary: Afghan women seeking education in Iran and Pakistan face growing barriers. Restrictive immigration rules, poverty, and local instability are blocking their access to schools. Many students can no longer continue their studies in exile due to these compounding pressures. Many Afghan girls and women have moved to Iran and Pakistan to pursue their education in high schools and universities. But restrictive immigration policies, poverty, and instability in both countries have made it increasingly difficult for them to continue their studies in exile.

articles.title: Bahrain Says It Intercepted Iranian Attacks As Tehran Claims Strike On US Base
articles.summary: Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks on November 15 after explosions and sirens sounded across the kingdom. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the strike targeted a US military installation. Bahraini air defenses destroyed the incoming projectiles during the incident. Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on November 15, after explosions and air raid sirens were reported across the Gulf kingdom and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it had targeted a US military installation.

articles.title: 160 questions, only one wrong: top scorer in South Korea tax exam admits AI cheating
articles.summary: The top scorer on South Korea’s tax accountant exam admitted to using generative AI. He confessed to sending photos of questions to a tool to cheat. The scandal raises concerns ahead of the national college entrance exam scheduled for next week. Fears for national college entrance exam next week as test taker admits sending photos of questions to AI toolThe marks attained by the top scorer ⁠on South Korea’s national exam for aspiring tax accountants this year seemed too good to be true.

articles.title: Ukraine Says Starshield Restrictions Persist, Hampering Drone Defenses
articles.summary: Ukraine reports that Starshield restrictions remain widespread. These limits hamper the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered drones near the front line. Moscow gains more opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets as a result. Ukraine says restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering the military’s ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones near the front line and giving Moscow additional opportunities to strike Ukrainian targets.

articles.title: One Tehran Street Becomes Battleground Over Personal Freedom
articles.summary: Tehran's Iranshahr Street has become a gathering spot for young Iranians seeking personal freedom. It has also emerged as a flashpoint in a growing confrontation between authorities and Generation Z members. Tehran's Iranshahr Street has become a popular gathering place for young Iranians seeking to express themselves freely. But as Radio Farda's Hannah Kaviani explains, it has also emerged as a flashpoint in a growing confrontation between authorities and members of Iran's Generation Z.

articles.title: Preparing for drought in Central America
articles.summary: Anastacio Martínez Gómez, 73, farms in southwestern Honduras where the Dry Corridor’s unpredictable rains dictate survival. His decades of experience cannot fully offset the region’s intensifying drought cycles. Across Central America, farming families face shrinking yields as seasonal patterns grow erratic. The corridor’s climate volatility now outpaces traditional agricultural knowledge. Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains.

articles.title: Ethereum’s ERC-8415 tests tokenization’s ownership gap
articles.summary: OKXICE plans to launch 24-hour trading for tokenized securities for US investors on November 23. The venture is a joint effort between OKX and Intercontinental Exchange. Most companies in the initial lineup objected to inclusion. This resistance highlights ownership gaps in tokenization. On November 23, OKXICE, a joint venture between crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange owner Intercontinental Exchange, plans to let eligible US investors trade tokenized securities around the clock.

articles.title: Amid Ongoing Battle Over Afghan Deportations, US Legislators Push Law Granting Protection
articles.summary: US legislators are pushing a new law to halt Afghan deportation flights. The plan to send 150 Afghans home sparked safety fears. Court battles have already emerged over the deportations. The proposed legislation aims to stop the flights from taking off. US plans to deport 150 Afghans back to their homeland have sparked fears for their safety and have led to court battles.

articles.title: Dollars Rain From Balcony As Kazakhstan's State Giants Rocked By Corruption Arrests
articles.summary: President Toqaev convened an urgent Security Council meeting after corruption arrests. Security services detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and KTZ. These entities control 40 percent of Kazakhstan's economy. Toqaev aimed to reassure foreign investors and reinforce his law and order drive. Days after security services detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and state railway KTZ, which control 40 percent of Kazakhstan’s economy, President Toqaev convened an urgent Security Council meeting to reinforce his “Law and Order” drive, address transport governance, and reassure foreign investors.

articles.title: Huang’s fall exposes contradictions in America’s China strategy
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia chief executive this week. His departure followed governance concerns and intelligence allegations. Washington imposed chip controls in 2022 and tightened them in 2023. Huang's fall exposed contradictions in America's China strategy. Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia chief executive this week followed a convergence of corporate governance concerns, intelligence allegations and scrutiny of semiconductor exports to China.

articles.title: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
articles.summary: The Gulf region remains tense nearly nine months after strikes on Iran. Iran has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. Attacks on vessels are increasing in frequency. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the situation. Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge.

articles.title: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
articles.summary: Armed groups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are obstructing Ebola response efforts. They continue attacking civilians and health workers. These disruptions hinder containment measures. UN responders reported the ongoing violence on Friday. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.

articles.title: CENTCOM Denies Iranian Claim It Struck A US Radar In Bahrain
articles.summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps claims it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain. This follows an overnight strike on Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command denied the Iranian assertion. The incident escalates regional tensions. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) claims that it destroyed a US military early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for an overnight air strike on the southern port town of Sirik, near the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Did China’s ‘beauty stratagem’ find a new victim in Jensen Huang?
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following reports of an affair with Alice Huang. She is a Singapore-based executive suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence. The incident has raised concerns about a potential honey trap targeting a major American technology leader. Extramarital activities have led to the resignation of one of America’s most influential tech bosses, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
articles.summary: Storm Charles brought heavy rain and strong winds to southern Europe. Portugal and southern Spain faced significant flooding and flight cancellations. The weather system first hit the island of Madeira before moving toward the mainland on 11 November. Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninusla this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain.

articles.title: China’s demographic challenge becoming its biotech advantage
articles.summary: The Biotechnology Innovation Organization urged Washington to adopt a national biotechnology strategy. The group warned that China is rapidly gaining ground in the sector. Biotech is now viewed as critical to economic competitiveness and national security in the U. S. Is biotechnology becoming the next space race? The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) appears to think so. This month, it urged Washington to adopt a comprehensive national biotechnology strategy, warning that China is rapidly gaining ground in an industry now viewed as critical to economic competitiveness and national security.

articles.title: Russia's Propaganda Machine Deploys Pro-War AI Songs
articles.summary: A Ukrainian nonprofit found nearly 1,000 AI-generated songs on Russian streaming platforms. The tracks support the military and the war in Ukraine. The content aims to generate patriotic sentiment among listeners. The study highlights the scale of this digital propaganda effort. Russians using streaming music sites might find a new genre turning up in their feeds: AI-generated songs in support of Russia's military and the war in Ukraine.

articles.title: Russian Diesel Tankers Turned Away From US, But Ukraine Says Moscow Is Still Finding Buyers
articles.summary: Russian diesel tankers bound for the United States changed course after failing to find American buyers. Political and legal opposition to the Trump administration's push for Russian fuel imports blocked the deals. Ukraine reports Moscow is still securing alternative buyers for the cargoes. Several Russian diesel tankers initially bound for the United States have changed course after struggling to find American buyers willing to accept the controversial cargoes, amid mounting political and legal opposition to the Trump administration's efforts to facilitate Russian fuel imports.

articles.title: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis
articles.summary: The World Food Programme chief warned that funding cuts are deepening Sudan's hunger crisis. He visited displaced families struggling to feed their children during his first field mission. Aid remains the only viable option for millions facing starvation in the conflict zone. The World Food Programme’s (WFP) new Executive Director has warned that funding cuts are worsening Sudan’s hunger crisis following his first field mission to the country, where he met families displaced by conflict and struggling to feed their children.

articles.title: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes
articles.summary: UN agencies launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya to secure over $3 billion in risk financing. The initiative aims to protect 75 million people from climate shocks by 2030. This move seeks to move funds before disasters strike. UN agencies on Thursday launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, that aims to secure access to more than $3 billion in risk financing to protect 75 million people and their livelihoods from climate shocks and natural hazards by 2030.

articles.title: Cities rise up the climate agenda as leaders face demands for action
articles.summary: World leaders at COP31 focused on protecting cities and vulnerable communities from climate impacts. Activists simultaneously challenged governments to implement stronger action. The human cost of rising seas and melting glaciers dominated the agenda. From flooded homes to melting Himalayan glaciers, the human cost of climate change took centre stage at COP31 on Thursday, as world leaders turned their attention to protecting cities and vulnerable communities, while activists challenged governments to do more.

articles.title: More than 1,000 killed between July and September, UN report reveals
articles.summary: A UN report states over 1,000 people were killed in Haiti between July and September. Armed gangs continue to terrorize residents in Port-au-Prince and surrounding areas. The violence persists despite ongoing international concerns. More than 1,000 people were killed in Haiti during the third quarter of this year, as armed gangs continue to terrorize the population in the capital Port-au-Prince and beyond, the UN team in the island nation, said in its latest human rights report.

articles.title: Argentinian lawyer mocks UK’s sovereignty claim in Falklands oil case
articles.summary: Argentine lawyer Marcelo Kohen told a Hamburg tribunal that Britain wrongly claims sovereignty over Falklands waters. He rejected the historic doctrine of Dominium maris Britannici. Kohen argued the UK cannot act as a 17th-century colonial power. The hearing challenges Britain's legal basis for controlling the region. Lawyer says Britain wrong to believe in historic doctrine that crown has sovereignty over parts of oceansBritain should not be permitted to act as a 17th-century colonial power treating the waters around the Falkland Islands as a Dominium maris Britannici, Argentina has told an international tribunal. Marcelo Kohen, representing Argentina at a hearing in Hamburg, mocked Britain for apparently belie.

articles.summary: उत्तर कोरिया के एक वरिष्ठ अधिकारी रूस दौरे पर हैं। यह यात्रा दर्शाती है कि यूक्रेन युद्ध में समझौते की स्थिति से असंतुष्ट रहते हुए भी प्योंगयांग मॉस्को को सैन्य सहायता जारी रखेगा। Russia-North Korea Relation: कुछ दिनों पहले नॉर्थ कोरिया के सर्वोच्च नेता किम जोंग उन कुछ दिनों पहले चीन पहुंचे थे और अब उनके करीबी सहयोगियों में से एक माने जाने वाले उत्तर कोरियाई अधिकारी रूस दौरे पर हैं.

articles.title: होर्मुज स्ट्रेट में तेल के दो जहाज बने समुद्री बारूदी सुरंगों के शिकार, धमाके के बाद जलकर हुए खाक
articles.summary: होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य में ईरान द्वारा बिछाई गई समुद्री बारूदों से दो तेल जहाजों को नुकसान हुआ। दोनों जहाजों में आग लग गई और वे जलकर खाक हो गए। होर्मुज स्ट्रेट (Strait of Hormuz) में बिछी समुद्री बारूदी सुरंगों (Naval Mines) से जहाज बच नहीं पा रहे हैं। ईरान (Iran) ने इस रणनीतिक जलमार्ग को बंद कर रखा है और अमेरिका (United States of America) की नेवी द्वारा सुझाए गए रास्तों को अवैध घोषित कर रखा है।

articles.summary: पूर्व अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति जो बाइडेन की आगामी पुस्तक में नेतन्याहू पर गंभीर आरोप लगाए गए। बाइडेन का कहना है कि उन्होंने गाजा में बढ़ती नागरिक मृत्युओं को लेकर प्रधानमंत्री से निजी तौर पर चिंता जताई थी। अमेरिका के पूर्व राष्ट्रपति व डेमोक्रेट पार्टी के नेता जो बाइडेन की किताब ‘प्रॉमिस मी, अमेरिका’ 17 नवंबर को रिलीज होगी। इसके कुछ अंश CNN ने शुक्रवार को प्रकाशित किए।

articles.summary: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने राहुल गांधी पर देश की बदनामी करने का आरोप लगाया। शाह का कहना है कि कांग्रेस लगातार हार के कारण हताशा में है और सत्ता पाने के लिए देशभक्ति का प्रदर्शन कर रही है। केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने हैदराबाद में अंतरराष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन में की गईं टिप्पणियों को लेकर राहुल गांधी पर निशाना साधा, उन्होंने कहा- कांग्रेस नेता भारत को बदनाम कर रहे हैं.

articles.summary: पाकिस्तानी सेना के पूर्व अधिकारी कैप्टन रहमान गुल को बलूच लिबरेशन आर्मी का कमांडर इन चीफ नियुक्त किया गया। 42 वर्षीय गुल पहले मजीद ब्रिगेड के डिप्टी कमांडर थे। वे जफर एक्सप्रेस हमले के मुख्य सूत्रधार भी थे। पाकिस्तान के बलूचिस्तान प्रांत में पाकिस्तानी सेना के खिलाफ सशस्त्र लड़ाई लड़ने वाले संगठन बलूच लिबरेशन आर्मी (BLA) की कमान अब पाकिस्तानी सेना के पूर्व अधिकारी कैप्टन रहमान गुल उर्फ उस्ताद मुरीद को दी गई है.

articles.summary: टीएमसी सांसद कल्याण बनर्जी ने बीजेपी सरकार पर पश्चिम बंगाल में बंगालियों को दूसरे दर्जे का नागरिक बनाने का आरोप लगाया। उन्होंने हवाड़ा स्टेशन पर छठ पूजा की सजावट को लेकर यह बयान दिया। टीएमसी सांसद कल्याण बनर्जी ने पश्चिम बंगाल की बीजेपी सरकार और मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी पर निशाना साधा है. उन्होंने कहा है कि भाजपा और मुख्यमंत्री के आशीर्वाद से 'कट्टरपंथी' गैर बंगाली भाषी लोगों की वजह से पश्चिम बंगाल में बंगालियों को दूसरे दर्जे का नागरिक बना दिया गया है.

articles.summary: चेस्टर क्राउन कोर्ट ने भारतीय बिलाल काजी को 30 साल की सज़ा सुनाई। उसने 70 बच्चियों को ब्लैकमेल कर अश्लील तस्वीरें मांगी थीं। उसके फोन से 900 से अधिक अश्लील सामग्री मिली थी। यूके की चेस्‍टर क्राउन कोर्ट ने भारतीय युवक बिलाल काजी को बच्चियों से चैटिंग के दौरान अश्‍लील तस्‍वीरें मांगने, ना देने पर ब्‍लैकमेल करने और सोशल मीडिया पर फर्जी अकाउंट बनाकर यौन उत्‍पीड़न से जुड़े 37 मामलों में दोषी करार दिया.

articles.title: पाकिस्तान के मंत्री के भारत दौरे पर मनीष तिवारी का रिएक्शन, 'देखना बाकी है कि...'
articles.summary: पाकिस्तान के जलवायु मंत्री डॉ. मुसादिक मसूद मलिक भारत में होने वाली एससीओ समिट में शामिल होंगे। कांग्रेस सांसद मनीष तिवारी ने इस पर कहा कि पिछले चार दशक में स्थिति नहीं बदली। उन्होंने पाकिस्तान पर आतंकवाद के नेटवर्क को बनाए रखने का आरोप लगाया। भारत में होने वाली एससीओ समिट में पाकिस्तान के जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्री डॉ. मुसादिक मसूद मलिक शामिल होंगे.

articles.title: पाकिस्तानी सेना का बागी कैप्टन रहमान गुल बना बलूच लिबरेशन आर्मी का कमांडर-इन-चीफ, आसिम मुनीर की
articles.summary: बलूच लिबरेशन आर्मी ने वरिष्ठ कमांडर रहमान गुल को नया कमांडर-इन-चीफ नियुक्त किया है। गुल को उस्ताद मुरीद या मुरीद बलूच के नाम से भी जाना जाता है। यह नियुक्ति पाकिस्तान के बलूचिस्तान प्रांत में सक्रिय इस अलगाववादी संगठन ने की है। पाकिस्तान (Pakistan) के बलूचिस्तान (Balochistan) प्रांत में सक्रिय अलगाववादी संगठन बलूच लिबरेशन आर्मी – बीएलए (Baloch Liberation Amy – BLA) ने अपने लिए नए कमांडर-इन-चीफ को चुन लिया है।
